metadata.name: peer.apply
metadata.description: the security core (dispatch): validate an inbound remote message against the 4 rules (setValue-only, namespace allowlist, 函 quarantine, no secret exfil) + setValue if it passes. Returns the decision.

metadata.name: peer.broadcast
metadata.description: outbound (dispatch): ship the VALUES of changed cels in the shared namespace to the peer (never structure/executable/secret shapes).

metadata.name: peer.connect
metadata.description: install a transport ({send} — a fake channel in tests, an RTCDataChannel wrapper in the browser).

metadata.name: peersend
metadata.description: (key, value) - explicit share: setValue locally + broadcast to the peer. Demo shim until automatic sync rides the post-cascade seam.

metadata.name: peerallow
metadata.description: ([prefix, …]) - the shared-namespace allowlist (default ["shared."]); remote writes outside it are dropped. =peerallow("*") denies all. No args shows the policy.

metadata.name: peerlog
metadata.description: () - the peer wiretap: inbound/outbound messages + the gate's decision for each.

metadata.name: peerOffer
metadata.description: () - WebRTC: mint an SDP offer (copy it to the other browser). Browser-only.

metadata.name: peerAnswer
metadata.description: (offer) - WebRTC: accept an offer, return the answer (copy back to the offerer). Browser-only.

metadata.name: peerAccept
metadata.description: (answer) - WebRTC: finalize the connection on the offerer side; the data channel opens. Browser-only.

metadata.name: cascade.observe
metadata.description: kernel post-mutation hook: auto-broadcast the shared-namespace keys a host just wrote to the connected peer (makes the sheet live)
